glosses: inhabitant (anyone who lives or dwells in something, especially a country, region, settlement)
an inhabitant without the full rights of a citizen; now used in the form Inwohner in historic terminology

examples.en: The city has a large population.

examples.text: Das Dorf hatte mehr als tausend Einwohner.
examples.en: The village had more than a thousand inhabitants.

examples.text: Die Einwohner flüchten aus der Stadt.
Alle Einwohner sind aufgefordert, zu Hause zu bleiben.
examples.en: Residents are urged to stay indoors.

examples.text: Mehr als 70 Prozent der Einwohner begünstigen das Programm.
examples.en: More than 70 percent of the inhabitants are in favor of the program.
